$room..write: auth != null && ((!data.exists() && newData.child('host').val() == auth.uid) || data.child('host').val() == auth.uid)

created..validate: newData.isNumber() && ((!data.exists() && newData.val() <= now + 10000 && newData.val() > now - 60000) || newData.val() == data.val())

expires..validate: newData.isNumber() && newData.val() <= newData.parent().child('created').val() + 900000 && newData.val() > now && (!data.exists() || newData.val() == data.val())

joiner..write: auth != null && !data.exists() && newData.val() == auth.uid && data.parent().child('expires').val() > now && data.parent().child('host').val() != auth.uid

answer..write: auth != null && data.parent().child('joiner').val() == auth.uid && data.parent().child('expires').val() > now && !data.exists()
